acceptance.assertion: Confirm whether Transcend Elite/OTBservice is needed; if not needed, disable or remove it reversibly and prove the previously observed handle growth of roughly 168 handles in 9 seconds no longer exists after reboot or service restart.
Classify current autostarts by required workflow and disable only unnecessary always-on helpers; preserve explicitly needed photo, scanner, backup, Tailscale, SSH and RustDesk functionality.
Verify the actual realtime-antivirus ownership and Avira background footprint; avoid running redundant realtime scanners and record any security-product change with postflight protection status.

Identify processes that keep the RTX 2060 awake during ordinary desktop use, prefer integrated graphics for non-GPU-intensive applications where safe, and prove the discrete GPU can return to a lower-power idle state when no GPU workload is intended.

After changes and a clean reboot, record CPU/RAM/disk/background-process state and Acer EC temperatures under comparable light load; show improvement without attributing unresolved physical cooling limits to software alone.

goal: Eliminate confirmed software-side resource leakage and unnecessary persistent background load on Joerg's laptop while preserving required photo, backup and security workflows, then prove that idle responsiveness and thermal load improve.

does_not_establish: Transcend Elite is unused by Joerg
Avira realtime redundancy with Defender without explicit provider-state verification
Firefox is permanently forced to the RTX by a user GPU preference
software cleanup alone will fix the high CPU temperature
metadata.live_finding: Transcend OTBservice version 1.0.0.0 was auto-running with more than 47,000 handles and grew from 47,367 to 47,535 handles in 9 seconds while no USB/removable disk was attached. Avira Endpoint Protection used about 513 MB RAM in the sampled process set; numerous vendor/media/update helpers auto-start. RTX 2060 was in P0 at about 22 W and 59-65 C while Firefox was the visible active 3D-GPU process.
metadata.next_action: Handle OTBservice first because the resource leak is directly proven, then reduce only workflow-unnecessary startup/GPU/background load and compare a clean-reboot baseline.
metadata.source: Live investigation of joerg-laptop after reported overheating/slowness

rollback.strategy: Before disabling or removing each startup/service component record the exact service/startup entry and restoration path. Re-enable any component whose required photo, backup, scanner, security or remote-access function regresses.

title: Remove Jörg laptop software performance leaks
